ModMetaData.name: The Ark
ModMetaData.author: Joe McDonagh
ModMetaData.description:
The Ark is a nomadic gravship total conversion for RimWorld.
The ship is the colony.
Land. Explore. Salvage. Survive. Escape.
M1: Persistent campaign foundation. M2/V1.1: Dev Mode campaign debug UI + New Game playtest scenario (The Ark).
Requires Odyssey. Gravship wreckage start is not in the playtest scenario yet — campaign tooling first.
